messages:
nina_cs: Heads up - Azureon flagged a surprise embedding workload after enabling semantic search. Their trial credits are burning faster than expected. Can we do a fast triage for the QBR next week?
lee_fin: On it. Do we have per-route token delta? Need embeddings vs other APIs.
omar_se: Early look: embeddings jumped from ~18M/day -> ~78M/day over 10d, avg embed dims stayed same but they increased history length in client calls.
rafa_prod: That's huge. For the customer-facing QBR slide we should show: baseline, surge, root cause, mitigations, and savings estimate. Nina, can you pull the exact 7d/30d numbers?
nina_cs: Pasted from monitoring snapshot: 
```
window: 7d
avg_tokens_day_pre: 18,200,000
avg_tokens_day_now: 78,300,000
embed_pct_of_tokens: 68%
estimated_weekly_overage: $3,900
```
lee_fin: Good. I'll model 3 scenarios: (A) no changes (B) apply client batching + reduce history to 3 items (C) apply prefix caching + smaller dims. Add a renewal risk tag if they hit <5 days of cushion.
anya_eng: We can push a short-lived server-side mitigation: enforce sampling for low-signal queries and cap per-session history at 3 vectors. I can open a staging config PR.
omar_se: Also recommend client-side dedupe on frequent searches and an option to downsample infrequent queries to 128 dims. I'll draft a playbook snippet.
rafa_prod: For options, include: 1) throttle ingest route, 2) enable prefix KV cache, 3) offer Dedicated trial or committed credits for predictable unit cost. Show projected weekly spend under each.
nina_cs: I'll reach out to @azureon-team for a 20m pre-QBR to walk through ops playbook. Propose Wed 10am PT. Thoughts?
lee_fin: Wed 10am PT works. Please ask them to share any recent client changes (SDK versions, param changes).
deploy-bot: deploy:feature/azureon-sampling v1 deployed to staging (logs: https://ci.redwood/release/AZ-998) :white_check_mark:
anya_eng: Quick config snippet for staging test: 
```
route: /v1/azureon/embeds
rate_limit: 150rps burst=300
session_history_limit: 3
sampling: low_signal_prob=0.25
batch_size: 48
```
omar_se: I'll prepare the deck numbers. Preliminary projection: current weekly spend ~$10.6k -> no-change $14.5k -> mitigation B ~$8.2k -> mitigation C ~$7.6k. Include conservative buffer.
rafa_prod: Add a slide with suggested email for renewals: explain spike, show mitigation path, propose short Dedicated trial or commit to smooth renewal.
lee_fin: I'll wire the credit cushion alert into the account health feed and set an automated Slack nudge when cushion < 5 days.
nina_cs: Action list: Nina book pre-QBR, Omar deck + savings table, Lee add alert, Anya test staging config, Rafa write renewal email draft. Check back Thu AM? :+1: 
omar_se: Thu AM fine. I'll include rollback steps and telemetry checks.
rafa_prod: Thanks team. Nina, ping me once pre-QBR confirmed and I'll add to the QBR agenda.
_meta: Synthetic Slack thread: Customer success cost/QBR prep for Azureon embedding surge. One continuous string of messages prefixed by sender names, matching agents.md schema.
